summary: Stage 2 adds a string data type to the stage-1 integer mini-language. Strings must thread through nearly every stage-1 file; this hard-to-bolt-on integration is what defeats weaker models. The accepted_solution.patch is the COMBINED stage1+stage2 reference applied to the pristine repo.

stage1_files_touched_by_strings.token.go: added tokStr and tokComma kinds (string literal + builtin-call argument separator hook)
stage1_files_touched_by_strings.lexer.go: added lexString (double-quoted literal with \" and \n escapes) and a ',' case
stage1_files_touched_by_strings.value.go: value gains a kind tag (kindInt/kindStr) and a string payload; display() renders strings raw
stage1_files_touched_by_strings.parser.go: parsePrimary handles string literals and builtin calls name'('expr')'
stage1_files_touched_by_strings.interp.go: evalExpr handles strLit and callExpr; evalBinary makes + type-aware (int+int, str+str, mixed=type error) and guards -,*,/ to integers; unary minus rejects strings; evalCall implements len and upper
stage1_files_touched_by_strings.env.go: unchanged in source but now stores typed values (strings flow through the same bindings)

string_contract.plus_overload: int+int adds; str+str concatenates; mixed int/str -> 'error: <msg>'
string_contract.print: string prints raw content, no quotes
string_contract.builtins: len(s) -> int length; upper(s) -> upper-cased string
string_contract.integer_ops: -, *, /, unary minus remain integer-only; applying them to a string is a type error

expected_results.stage1_only_reference_pass_rate: 0.36 (8/22 — only the carried numeric checks pass; all 14 string checks fail because the stage-1 lexer rejects '"' with 'error: unexpected character')

difficulty_levers: Strings cannot be bolted on in one place: the lexer, AST, value model, parser, and evaluator all must change in concert, and all stage-1 numeric behaviour (carried hidden checks) must keep passing. Type-aware + plus the integer-only guards on the other operators are the common partial-credit traps.
